record.question: Who is the current Chief Minister of Nagaland?
record.explanation: Answer C: Neiphiu Rio. Neiphiu Rio became Nagaland Chief Minister on 8 March 2018, so he was the incumbent at the June 2018 paper date. Nagaland DIPR’s original April 2018 magazine documents the swearing-in, superseding T R Zeliang. Historical/source note: Historical June 2018 incumbent; do not use the stale late 2017 T R Zeliang answer. Reference: https://ipr.nagaland.gov.in/sites/default/files/2020-02/THE%20WARRIOR%20APRIL%202018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
